name: Oblong-leaved Sundew
desc: Oblong-leaved Sundew (Drosera intermedia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 42 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Drosera intermedia, commonly known as the oblong-leaved sundew, spoonleaf sundew, or spatulate leaved sundew, is an insectivorous plant species belonging to the sundew genus.
